name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit facing the pad of a pec-deck machine and grip the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your chest against the pad.
Pull your arms back until they are in line with your shoulders.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A machine reverse fly for the rear delts and upper back.
